about.heading: About Us
about.title: We are BTE Germany.
about.paragraph: BTE Germany is a community-driven Minecraft project dedicated to recreating the entirety of Germany in meticulous detail. Our mission is to build an accurate and immersive representation of Germany's cities, landscapes, and landmarks within the Minecraft universe.

community.heading: Our Community
community.title: A passionate community of builders.
community.paragraph: At BTE Germany, our strength lies in our vibrant and dedicated community of Minecraft enthusiasts. Together, we collaborate to bring the vision of Germany to life, sharing ideas, skills, and creativity to ensure every detail is captured with precision.

cta.title: Become a part of something big.
cta.paragraph: Join BTE Germany today and contribute to the largest Minecraft project in Germany. Whether you're an experienced builder or just starting out, there's a place for you in our community. Help us shape the future of BTE Germany and leave your mark on this incredible journey.

hero.title: Our Story
hero.subText: Did you know: Our mission to recreate the entire earth 1:1 within Minecraft already started way back in 2020. Let's take a quick look back at some of the most important milestones that shaped the project into what it has become today.

1.info: American YouTuber PippenFTS uploads his video "The Earth in Minecraft, 1:1 scale... for the first time" showcasing a full recreation of the earth's terrain. Following his call to populate the still empty surface builders all around the world start to organize.

cta.title: And in the future?
cta.paragraph: Together our community has already experienced a variety of historical milestones with many more to come. Interested in becoming a first-hand spectator of our future or even help in shaping it yourself? Become a member of our community today and join us on our mission!
